CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  April 12, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: At 7:30 p.m. on April 12, 2022, the Design Review Board
  convened in the Conference Room A of the Alhambra City Hall.

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA
All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: MINUTES

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez,
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 317 S. 2nd St.
This is an application for a new patio deck and balcony for an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Ronald Ballesteros, Form B Studio, Inc.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The railing color shall be white to match the existing color palette; and 2. Details and specifications
of the new windows shall be documented and reviewed by DRB staff prior to plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant and the contractor were present.

  1
 Hernandez confirmed that the color and materials are to match existing.

Udani confirmed that the balcony and deck are the new scope of work.

The applicant stated that the windows are to be vinyl double hung. All windows will be replaced.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The railing color shall be white to match the existing color palette; and
  2. Details and specifications of the new windows shall be documented and reviewed by
  DRB staff prior to plan check.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 3: 200 N. Vega St.
This is an application for a new 1,624 square foot two-story single-family residence and a new 6'
brick wall.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The applicant shall include the driveway gate and sideyard gate details; and 2. The landscape
drawings shall be provided prior to the building plan check to address both design and MWELO
compliance as needed.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant provided renderings for board review.

Udani confirmed that the vertical siding was to scale.

Daninger questioned if the AC unit and water heater was shown on the renderings. He stated that
the metal water heater enclosure should be painted to match the house.

Tsai questioned the orientation of the siding and the proportions of the entry porch roof.

Discussion ensued regarding the slope of the entry roof. It was suggested that the slope be increased
to reduce the negative space at the top of the roof ridge.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall include the driveway gate and sideyard gate details;
  2. The siding shall be consistently vertically oriented;
  3. The roof at the front porch shall be modified in slope or elevation;
  4. The water heater enclosure shall be painted to match the new house; and

  2
   5. The landscape drawings shall be provided prior to the building plan check to address
  both design and MWELO compliance as needed.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 4: 301 S. Atlantic Blvd.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
Sign panels for the prospective tenants shall be provided within the documentation (both graphics
and detailing); 2. Ownership approvals shall be provided at the time of plan check; and 3. Any
design-related changes shall be documented and reviewed by DRB staff prior to plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
Daninger confirmed that the Psychic booth will be removed

Udani confirmed that the sign stucco will match the building.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall remove the awning in its entirety when either one or both spaces are
  leased.; and
  2. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to permit
  issuance.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 5: 1515 S. 8th St.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The garage shall be code compliant with a 10-yard setback; and 2. All revised drawings shall be
documented and reviewed by staff prior to plan check submittal.

ACTION MINUTES:
Tsai questioned if the elevations were correct. Discussion ensued regarding the curved eave detail.
The cantilevered eaves of the house are shown incorrectly and should be flush to the wall. The
covering of the front door and the material of the garage door were also discussed with no change
required.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:

  3
   1. The garage shall be code compliant with a 10-yard setback; and
  2. All revised drawings shall be documented and reviewed by staff prior to plan check
  submittal.
  •  The second was by Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ADJOURNMENT:
Udani stated that the next DRB meeting is cancelled and we will adjourn to the next meeting on
May 10, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:20 p.m.
 •  Seconded by Tsai
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 10th day of May, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
